steps.prompt_exact: Could you build me a phone-friendly one-file HTML board for planning YouTube uploads where I can draft title, tag, and description options, see title safe-zone/truncation meters, catch duplicate or keyword-stuffed tags, balance tag clusters, and copy a clean upload handoff?
steps.response_exact:
Now let me plan and build this tool. This is a creative productivity tool for YouTube creators — I'll design something that feels native to the content creation world, not a generic dashboard.

Design plan:

- Palette: Deep charcoal #1A1A2E base, YouTube crimson #FF0033 as anchor accent, electric amber #FFBE00 for warnings, cool slate #E8ECF0 for surfaces — feels like a creator studio at night
- Type: System stack tuned for density — SF Pro/-apple-system for readability, monospace for character counts and tag tokens
- Layout: Single-scroll vertical column, phone-first (100vw max 480px), sticky header with upload status
- Signature: The title safe-zone meter is a real horizontal scroll-shadow visualization that mimics what YouTube actually clips — the most memorable element on the page
- Sections: Title Workshop → Tag Lab → Description Builder → Upload Handoff

Let me build this:

Created a file, read a file

Here's your YouTube Upload Board. It lives in four tabs:

Title — Type your working title and watch a live character meter (green → amber → red as you approach limits). The safe-zone preview shows exactly what YouTube will display on desktop (60 chars) and mobile/search (47 chars), with the clipped text struck through in red and a character count badge. Draft variants sit below — hit USE to promote any variant to the active title.

Tags — Type a tag and press Add (or Enter), or paste a comma-separated batch. The cloud auto-clusters tags by shared stem and color-codes each cluster so you can see topic balance at a glance. Issues flag in real time: duplicates, near-duplicates (where one tag is a prefix of another), keyword stuffing (5+ words in a single tag), going over the 500-char YouTube limit, and too-few-tags warnings.

Description — Full textarea with a 5,000-char meter and a live "above the fold" preview showing exactly what viewers see before they click Show more (~157 chars). Same variant system as the title tab.

Handoff — A readiness score ring (0–100%) backed by 8 specific checks, the full checklist, and three copy-ready boxes. One button copies the entire Title/Tags/Description block as a clean formatted paste.

Everything is a single self-contained HTML file, no CDN or external dependencies.
